CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_assign_pharmacy_admin(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_email text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pharmacy_id uuid, admin_email text, assignment_status text, admin_user_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_email text := lower(trim(p_email));
    v_user_id uuid;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.medryvo_is_system_owner() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'System Owner access required';
    END IF;

    IF p_pharmacy_id IS NULL
       OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.pharmacies p
            WHERE p.id = p_pharmacy_id
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pharmacy not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_email IS NULL OR position('@' in v_email) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Valid ADMIN email is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT u.id
    INTO v_user_id
    FROM auth.users u
    WHERE lower(u.email) = v_email
    LIMIT 1;

    UPDATE public.pharmacy_members pm
    SET active = false
    WHERE pm.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
      AND pm.role = 'admin'
      AND pm.active = true
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.system_owners so
          WHERE so.user_id = pm.user_id
      )
      AND (v_user_id IS NULL OR pm.user_id <> v_user_id);

    INSERT INTO public.pharmacy_admin_assignments (
        pharmacy_id,
        email,
        status,
        assigned_by,
        assigned_at,
        claimed_by,
        claimed_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_pharmacy_id,
        v_email,
        CASE WHEN v_user_id IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'claimed' END,
        auth.uid(),
        now(),
        v_user_id,
        CASE WHEN v_user_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END
    )
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT pharmacy_admin_assignments_pharmacy_id_key
    DO UPDATE SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        assigned_by = EXCLUDED.assigned_by,
        assigned_at = now(),
        claimed_by = EXCLUDED.claimed_by,
        claimed_at = EXCLUDED.claimed_at;

    IF v_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.profiles (
            user_id,
            email,
            display_name
        )
        VALUES (
            v_user_id,
            v_email,
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SELECT u.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name'
                    FROM auth.users u
                    WHERE u.id = v_user_id
                ),
                split_part(v_email,'@',1)
            )
        )
        ON CONFLICT (user_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            email = EXCLUDED.email,
            updated_at = now();

        INSERT INTO public.pharmacy_members (
            pharmacy_id,
            user_id,
            role,
            active
        )
        VALUES (
            p_pharmacy_id,
            v_user_id,
            'admin',
            true
        )
        ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT pharmacy_members_pharmacy_id_user_id_key
        DO UPDATE SET
            role = 'admin',
            active = true;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        p_pharmacy_id,
        v_email,
        CASE WHEN v_user_id IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'active' END,
        v_user_id;
END;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_list_gtin_mapping_disputes(p_status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(dispute_id uuid, pharmacy_id uuid, pharmacy_name text, gtin text, current_item_code text, suggested_item_code text, suggested_item_name text, status text, reported_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_system_owner() then raise exception 'System Owner permission required'; end if;
    return query
    select d.id,d.pharmacy_id,p.name,d.gtin,d.current_item_code,d.suggested_item_code,
           d.suggested_item_name,d.status,d.reported_at
    from public.pharmflow_gtin_mapping_disputes_v1 d
    left join public.pharmacies p on p.id=d.pharmacy_id
    where p_status is null or d.status=lower(p_status)
    order by d.reported_at desc;
end $function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_list_pharmacies()
 RETURNS TABLE(pharmacy_id uuid, pharmacy_code text, pharmacy_name text, active boolean, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, approved_at timestamp with time zone, admin_user_id uuid, admin_email text, admin_name text, pending_admin_email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
begin
    if not public.medryvo_is_system_owner() then
        raise exception 'System Owner access required';
    end if;

    return query
    select
        p.id,
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.active,
        p.status,
        p.created_at,
        p.approved_at,
        au.id,
        coalesce(pr.email, au.email),
        pr.display_name,
        paa.email
    from public.pharmacies p
    left join lateral (
        select pm.user_id
        from public.pharmacy_members pm
        where pm.pharmacy_id = p.id
          and pm.role = 'admin'
          and pm.active = true
          and not exists (
              select 1 from public.system_owners so
              where so.user_id = pm.user_id
          )
        order by pm.created_at desc
        limit 1
    ) current_admin on true
    left join auth.users au on au.id = current_admin.user_id
    left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id = current_admin.user_id
    left join public.pharmacy_admin_assignments paa
        on paa.pharmacy_id = p.id
       and paa.status = 'pending'
    order by p.created_at asc, p.name asc;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_list_pharmacy_registrations(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, applicant_user_id uuid, applicant_email text, applicant_name text, pharmacy_name text, pharmacy_code text, request_status text, submitted_at timestamp with time zone, reviewed_at timestamp with time zone, review_note text, pharmacy_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_system_owner() then
        raise exception 'System Owner permission required';
    end if;

    return query
    select
        r.id,
        r.applicant_user_id,
        r.applicant_email,
        r.applicant_name,
        r.requested_pharmacy_name,
        r.requested_pharmacy_code,
        r.status,
        r.submitted_at,
        r.reviewed_at,
        r.review_note,
        r.pharmacy_id
    from public.pharmacy_registration_requests r
    where p_status is null
       or lower(r.status) = lower(p_status)
    order by
        case when r.status = 'pending' then 0 else 1 end,
        r.submitted_at desc;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_review_pharmacy_registration(p_request_id uuid, p_decision text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, request_status text, pharmacy_id uuid, pharmacy_code text, pharmacy_name text, admin_user_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_owner uuid := auth.uid();
    v_decision text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_decision,'')));
    v_req public.pharmacy_registration_requests%ROWTYPE;
    v_pharmacy uuid;
BEGIN
    IF v_owner IS NULL OR NOT public.is_system_owner() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'System Owner permission required';
    END IF;

    IF v_decision NOT IN ('approve','reject') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Decision must be approve or reject';
    END IF;

    SELECT r.*
    INTO v_req
    FROM public.pharmacy_registration_requests r
    WHERE r.id = p_request_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Registration request not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_req.status <> 'pending' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only pending requests can be reviewed';
    END IF;

    IF v_decision = 'reject' THEN
        UPDATE public.pharmacy_registration_requests r
        SET
            status = 'rejected',
            reviewed_at = now(),
            reviewed_by = v_owner,
            review_note = nullif(trim(p_note),'')
        WHERE r.id = p_request_id;

        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            v_req.id,
            'rejected'::text,
            NULL::uuid,
            v_req.requested_pharmacy_code,
            v_req.requested_pharmacy_name,
            v_req.applicant_user_id;

        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.pharmacies p
        WHERE upper(p.code) = upper(v_req.requested_pharmacy_code)
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pharmacy code is already in use';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.pharmacies (
        code,
        name,
        status,
        active,
        approved_at,
        approved_by
    )
    VALUES (
        upper(v_req.requested_pharmacy_code),
        v_req.requested_pharmacy_name,
        'active',
        true,
        now(),
        v_owner
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_pharmacy;

    INSERT INTO public.pharmacy_members (
        pharmacy_id,
        user_id,
        role,
        active
    )
    VALUES (
        v_pharmacy,
        v_req.applicant_user_id,
        'admin',
        true
    )
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT pharmacy_members_pharmacy_id_user_id_key
    DO UPDATE SET
        role = 'admin',
        active = true;

    UPDATE public.pharmacy_registration_requests r
    SET
        status = 'approved',
        reviewed_at = now(),
        reviewed_by = v_owner,
        review_note = nullif(trim(p_note),''),
        pharmacy_id = v_pharmacy
    WHERE r.id = p_request_id;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        v_req.id,
        'approved'::text,
        v_pharmacy,
        upper(v_req.requested_pharmacy_code),
        v_req.requested_pharmacy_name,
        v_req.applicant_user_id;
END;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_gtin_candidates_v3(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_mapping_id uuid, p_mapping_revision bigint, p_gtin text, p_old_item_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(transaction_id text, order_number text, item_code text, item_name text, gtin text, quantity integer, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, attribution text, classification text, reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    with candidates as (
        select t.*,
               exists (
                   select 1
                     from public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2 nr
                    where nr.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                      and nr.status = 'RESOLVED'
                      and nr.resolution_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
               ) as needs_review_linked,
               (
                   exists (
                       select 1
                         from public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2 nr
                        where nr.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                          and nr.status = 'RESOLVED'
                          and nr.resolution_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
                          and regexp_replace(coalesce(nr.gtin, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = p_gtin
                          and upper(trim(coalesce(nr.resolved_item_code, '')))
                              = upper(trim(p_old_item_code))
                          and upper(trim(coalesce(nr.order_number, '')))
                              = upper(trim(coalesce(t.order_number, '')))
                   )
                   and coalesce((
                       select sum(nr.pending_quantity)
                         from public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2 nr
                        where nr.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                          and nr.status = 'RESOLVED'
                          and nr.resolution_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
                          and regexp_replace(coalesce(nr.gtin, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = p_gtin
                          and upper(trim(coalesce(nr.resolved_item_code, '')))
                              = upper(trim(p_old_item_code))
                          and upper(trim(coalesce(nr.order_number, '')))
                              = upper(trim(coalesce(t.order_number, '')))
                   ), 0) = t.quantity
                   and not exists (
                       select 1
                         from public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2 nr
                        where nr.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                          and nr.status = 'RESOLVED'
                          and nr.resolution_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
                          and (
                              regexp_replace(coalesce(nr.gtin, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> p_gtin
                              or upper(trim(coalesce(nr.resolved_item_code, '')))
                                  <> upper(trim(p_old_item_code))
                              or upper(trim(coalesce(nr.order_number, '')))
                                  <> upper(trim(coalesce(t.order_number, '')))
                          )
                   )
               ) as needs_review_proven,
               (
                   t.payload #>> '{gtinResolution,kind}' = 'PHARMACY_LEARNED'
                   and t.payload #>> '{gtinResolution,mappingId}' = p_mapping_id::text
                   and t.payload #>> '{gtinResolution,mappingRevision}' = p_mapping_revision::text
                   and regexp_replace(
                       coalesce(t.payload #>> '{gtinResolution,normalizedGtin}', ''),
                       '[^0-9]', '', 'g'
                   ) = p_gtin
                   and upper(trim(coalesce(
                       t.payload #>> '{gtinResolution,resolvedItemCode}', ''
                   ))) = upper(trim(p_old_item_code))
               ) as provenance_proven,
               exists (
                   select 1
                     from public.pharmflow_receiving_transactions_v1 reversal
                    where reversal.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                      and reversal.payload #>> '{learnedGtinLifecycle,type}' = 'REVERSAL'
                      and reversal.payload #>> '{learnedGtinLifecycle,reversesTransactionId}'
                          = t.transaction_id
               ) as lifecycle_compensated,
               exists (
                   select 1
                     from public.pharmflow_receiving_transactions_v1 negative
                    where negative.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                      and negative.quantity < 0
                      and upper(trim(coalesce(negative.order_number, '')))
                          = upper(trim(coalesce(t.order_number, '')))
                      and upper(trim(coalesce(negative.item_code, '')))
                          = upper(trim(coalesce(t.item_code, '')))
                      and negative.occurred_at >= t.occurred_at
                      and coalesce(
                          negative.payload #>> '{learnedGtinLifecycle,type}', ''
                      ) <> 'REVERSAL'
               ) as unlinked_negative_conflict
          from public.pharmflow_receiving_transactions_v1 t
         where t.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
           and t.quantity > 0
           and regexp_replace(coalesce(t.gtin, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = p_gtin
           and upper(trim(t.item_code)) = upper(trim(p_old_item_code))
    )
    select c.transaction_id,
           coalesce(c.order_number, ''),
           c.item_code,
           coalesce(c.item_name, ''),
           coalesce(c.gtin, ''),
           c.quantity,
           c.occurred_at,
           case
               when c.provenance_proven then 'LEARNED_MAPPING_PROVENANCE_V3'
               when c.needs_review_proven then 'NEEDS_REVIEW_RESOLUTION'
               else 'UNPROVEN'
           end,
           case
               when c.lifecycle_compensated then 'ALREADY_COMPENSATED'
               when (c.provenance_proven or c.needs_review_proven)
                    and not c.unlinked_negative_conflict
                    and nullif(trim(coalesce(c.order_number, '')), '') is not null
                   then 'PROVABLE'
               else 'AMBIGUOUS'
           end,
           case
               when c.lifecycle_compensated then 'LIFECYCLE_REVERSAL_EXISTS'
               when c.unlinked_negative_conflict then 'UNLINKED_NEGATIVE_MAY_ALREADY_COMPENSATE'
               when nullif(trim(coalesce(c.order_number, '')), '') is null then 'MISSING_EXACT_ORDER_NUMBER'
               when c.needs_review_linked and not c.needs_review_proven
                   then 'NEEDS_REVIEW_QUANTITY_OR_GROUP_MISMATCH'
               when not (c.provenance_proven or c.needs_review_proven) then 'MISSING_LEARNED_MAPPING_PROVENANCE'
               else 'PROVABLE'
           end
      from candidates c;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_gtin_lifecycle_admin_v3(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    select public.pharmflow_gtin_lifecycle_member_v3(p_pharmacy_id)
       and (
            exists (
                select 1
                  from public.system_owners so
                 where so.user_id = auth.uid()
            )
            or exists (
                select 1
                  from public.pharmacy_members pm
                 where pm.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
                   and pm.user_id = auth.uid()
                   and pm.active is true
                   and lower(coalesce(pm.role, '')) = 'admin'
            )
       );
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_order_has_item_v3(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_order_number text, p_item_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
          from public.pharmflow_active_order_manifest_v1 m
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
              case
                  when jsonb_typeof(m.manifest -> 'orderData') = 'array'
                  then m.manifest -> 'orderData'
                  else '[]'::jsonb
              end
          ) item
         where m.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
           and lower(coalesce(m.manifest ->> 'active', 'false')) = 'true'
           and upper(trim(coalesce(item ->> 'itemCode', '')))
               = upper(trim(coalesce(p_item_code, '')))
           and exists (
               select 1
                 from jsonb_array_elements_text(
                     case
                         when jsonb_typeof(item -> 'orderNumbers') = 'array'
                         then item -> 'orderNumbers'
                         else '[]'::jsonb
                     end
                 ) order_value
                where upper(trim(order_value))
                    = upper(trim(coalesce(p_order_number, '')))
           )
    );
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_receiving_member_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    select auth.uid() is not null and (

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_receiving_sync_health_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(transaction_count bigint, last_transaction_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
    if not public.pharmflow_receiving_member_v2(p_pharmacy_id) then
        raise exception 'Pharmacy access required';

    return query
    select count(*)::bigint,max(t.occurred_at)
    from public.pharmflow_receiving_transactions_v1 t
    where t.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.query_pharmflow_expiry_inventory_v1(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_resolved boolean DEFAULT false, p_sort text DEFAULT 'ADDED'::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pharmflow_expiry_private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; filters jsonb:=coalesce(p_filters,'{}'::jsonb);
begin
  perform pharmflow_expiry_private.valid_auth_session();
  if public.is_pharmacy_member(p_pharmacy_id) is not true then raise exception 'Pharmacy access required'; end if;
  if p_filters is null or p_resolved is null or p_sort is null or p_offset is null or p_limit is null
     or p_limit not between 1 and 250 or p_offset<0 or jsonb_typeof(filters)<>'object'
     or p_sort not in ('ADDED','UPDATED','EXPIRY')
     or (filters ? 'groups' and jsonb_typeof(filters->'groups')<>'array')
     or (filters ? 'departments' and jsonb_typeof(filters->'departments')<>'array')
     or (filters ? 'operators' and (jsonb_typeof(filters->'operators')<>'array' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(filters->'operators')='array' then filters->'operators' else '[]'::jsonb end) v where jsonb_typeof(v)<>'string')))
     or (filters ? 'months' and jsonb_typeof(filters->'months')<>'array')
     or (filters ? 'include_unassigned' and jsonb_typeof(filters->'include_unassigned')<>'boolean') then
    raise exception 'Invalid inventory query';
  end if;
  with rows as materialized (
    select * from pharmflow_expiry_private.inventory_rows_group_v1(p_pharmacy_id,p_resolved)
  ), matching as materialized (
    select * from rows r where pharmflow_expiry_private.inventory_match_v1(case when coalesce(jsonb_array_length(filters->'operators'),0)>0 then pharmflow_expiry_private.inventory_operator_v1(p_pharmacy_id,to_jsonb(r)) else to_jsonb(r) end,filters)
  ), page as (
    select * from matching order by
      case when p_sort='EXPIRY' then expiry_year*12+expiry_month end asc,
      case when p_sort='UPDATED' or p_resolved then updated_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='ADDED' and not p_resolved then added_at end desc,row_id
    limit p_limit offset p_offset
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(pharmflow_expiry_private.inventory_operator_v1(p_pharmacy_id,to_jsonb(p))) from page p),'[]'::jsonb),
    'count',(select count(*) from matching),
    'units',(select coalesce(sum(quantity),0) from matching),
    'departments',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(d order by d),'[]'::jsonb) from (select distinct department d from rows) v),
    'groups',jsonb_build_array('Beauty','FMCG','HomeHealth','Medicine','Mom & Baby','Supplement'),
    'has_unassigned_group',(select exists(select 1 from rows where group_name is null)),
    'operators',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(v.name order by v.name),'[]'::jsonb) from (select distinct f.operator_name name from rows r join pharmflow_expiry_private.first_operator_v1 f on f.state_id=r.state_id and f.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id where nullif(btrim(f.operator_name),'') is not null) v),
    'months',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(m order by m),'[]'::jsonb) from (select distinct expiry_year::text||'-'||lpad(expiry_month::text,2,'0') m from rows) v)
  ) into result;
  return result;
end
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remove_pharmacy_learned_gtin_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_gtin text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare

    v_gtin text :=
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(p_gtin,''),
            '[^0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        );

    v_reason text :=
        trim(coalesce(p_reason,''));

    v_old public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1%rowtype;

begin

    if auth.uid() is null
       or not public.pharmflow_is_member(p_pharmacy_id)
    then
        raise exception 'Pharmacy access required';
    end if;

    -- System Owner OR pharmacy ADMIN
    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.system_owners so
        where so.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.pharmacy_members pm
        where pm.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
          and pm.user_id = auth.uid()
          and pm.active = true
          and lower(coalesce(pm.role,'')) = 'admin'
    )
    then
        raise exception
            'Pharmacy ADMIN access is required for GTIN corrections';
    end if;

    if length(v_gtin) < 8
       or v_reason = ''
    then
        raise exception
            'GTIN and Reason are required';
    end if;

    select *
      into v_old
      from public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1
     where pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
       and regexp_replace(
               gtin,
               '[^0-9]',
               '',
               'g'
           ) = v_gtin
     limit 1
     for update;

    if v_old.id is null then
        raise exception
            'No pharmacy-learned mapping exists for this GTIN';
    end if;

    insert into
    public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_audit_v1 (

        pharmacy_id,
        gtin,

        old_item_code,
        old_item_name,

        action,
        reason,

        changed_by

    )
    values (

        p_pharmacy_id,
        v_gtin,

        v_old.item_code,
        v_old.item_name,

        'REMOVE',
        v_reason,

        auth.uid()

    );

    delete
      from public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1
     where id = v_old.id;

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'scope', 'pharmacy',
        'action', 'REMOVE',
        'gtin', v_gtin,
        'old_item_code', v_old.item_code
    );

end;
$function$
;
